cycles.intent: Canonical green-dominant elongated oval hull,gold side fields and crown,slate gondolas and darker ventral casings. Derive colours/PBR from current canonical GLBs;preserve precision horns and articulated repair chains,and add separately closing jaws.
cycles.comparison_conditions: Actual canonical and engineering GLB imports rendered by the same studio function;independent framing for style review,not game scale.
observations: Reviewed actual engineering and canonical GLB imports in the same studio. Green-dominant elongated oval hull,gold fields/crown,slate gondolas and bronze/ventral casings share the Delphini Assault/Lazzaro family.
The rounded hull form is culturally supported by both canonical references;defined metal tool links remain separate from the curved body. No dense decorative panel grid.

Actual native/imported front,rear and top views plus 0/1/2/3-second working poses inspected. Precision horns retain rooted motion;repair shoulder/elbow positioning precedes independent jaw closure while the welding arm remains articulated.

Palette and effective PBR values are measured from current canonical GLB textures/factors. Untextured titanium/graphite factors are converted from linear RGB to sRGB map values. Graphite metalness/roughness are approximate within the shared material helper bounds;source hue is retained.

Function-specific tools and carrier proportions remain distinct from combat/research ships. Display is independently fitted;game scale and continuous swept clearance remain provisional. User artistic acceptance remains pending.
remaining: Graphite PBR approximation and deliberately different utility tooling.
Game scale,platform profiling and continuous swept clearance remain outside asset-proposal verification.

cycles.intent: Adopt canonical Rigellian hidef slate-jade/pale-alloy/copper/ochre palette and functional service detailing,keeping quiet curved skins and supported animated tools.
cycles.comparison_conditions: Independent current hidef and engineering GLB imports in the same studio;independent framing,not physical game scale.
observations: Native/imported models and six connected-support poses pass. Hidef palette and seated functional hatches match. Main skin remains too uninterrupted compared with the hidef formed shells;add sparse broad seams and a crew visor,without a regular panel grid.

cycles.intent: Complete hidef surface language with broad formed skin sections,recessed panoramic visor and rooted elliptical shoulder gasket. Keep articulated tools and detail budget.
cycles.comparison_conditions: Actual hidef and engineering GLBs in the same review studio;independent display framing.
observations: Actual native and imported front,rear,top views show seated broad skins,flush visor and shoulder seal,not the displaced third-cycle panels.

Slate-jade,pale-alloy,ochre and copper surfaces,seated cooling louvres and captive service lids share the corrected hidef family. Copper nacelle patches and their dark inspection fields conform to the actual nacelle mesh rather than a tangent plane;the independent verifier rejects flat or lifted patches. Functional tools and broad utility proportions remain distinct.
Six sampled native/import animation poses have connected support;repair retains shoulder/elbow positioning and independently moving jaws.
Independent attachment regression checks actual broad-skin distance to the body surface in all six poses and rejects a deliberately lifted panel in native and imported models.

The initial third-cycle repair render exposed a scaled-root inheritance defect despite passing the connected-support graph. The user-requested defect repair makes all added skins hull-local;the additional technical export is recorded,not hidden as a successful first attempt.
remaining: Authored utility proportions,game scale,GPU profiling and continuous swept clearance remain separate.

technical_repair.defect: New skins were authored in world coordinates after the repair root had been scaled;connected support did not establish close surface fitting.
technical_repair.fix: Parent skins and shoulder gasket to the body in body-local coordinates;direct surface-proximity assertions and independent lifted-panel negative control.

user_requested_followups: Repair displaced third-cycle panels by inheriting the hull transform.
Bend copper nacelle patches and dark insets to the actual curved housing surface.
